answer: Instead of filtering at signup, every reward waits one epoch in escrow at a settlement jetty. During the hold, the chain builds an activity plume for each key: a compact vector of funding sources, submission timing, and output-hash n-grams. Identities whose plumes lie close together collapse into one cluster; a slashable quartz bond posted at first payout is seized for the whole cluster, and only uncorrelated keys are released. A thousand lookalikes then lock more capital without earning more emissions.
